questions.q: What two places did Yahweh tell the people they could not behave like the people there?
questions.a: Yahweh told the people of Israel they could not behave like the Egyptians or Canaanites.

questions.q: What is one group of people with whom God forbade Israelites to have sexual relations?
questions.a: Yahweh told the people they could not have sexual relations with any close relative.

questions.q: Why is a man not to have sexual relations with a woman during her menstruation?
questions.a: A man may not have sexual relations with a woman during her menstruation, because during that time she is unclean.

questions.q: What may the people not sacrifice to Molech?
questions.a: The people may not sacrifice their children to Molech.

questions.q: What two sexual relations do verses 22 and 23 forbid?
questions.a: Verses 22 and 23 forbid sexual relations with other men or animals.

questions.q: What happened to the people who lived in the land before the people of Israel?
questions.a: The people, those who lived in the land before the people of Israel, defiled the land, and the land vomited them out.

questions.q: What will happen to any of the people or the foreigners who live among them who do any of these detestable things?
questions.a: God will remove from his people any of the people who do any of these abominable practices.

commentary.text: —Here is a law against all conformity to the corrupt usages of the heathen. Also laws against incest, against brutal lusts, and barbarous idolatries; and the enforcement of these laws from the ruin of the Canaanites. God here gives moral precepts. Close and constant adherence to God's ordinances is the most effectual preservative from gross sin. The grace of God only will secure us; that grace is to be expected only in the use of the means of grace. Nor does He ever leave any to their hearts' lusts, till they have left him and his services.
